literal_meaning: শরীরের জল (body's water, referring to sweat or bodily fluids)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার গায়ের জল ঠিক আছে, কোনো সমস্যা নেই।
এই ওষুধ খেয়ে গায়ের জল ফিরে পেয়েছি।
example_sentences_in_english: He is in good health, no issues.
After taking this medicine, I regained my health.
note: This idiom metaphorically links bodily vitality (like sweat indicating activity and health) to overall well-being in Bengali culture.
